name: Ravenwood Memorial Library
description: The main campus library, offering study rooms, printing services, and a large reference collection.
additional_info: Group study rooms can be reserved online
Silent study floor is the 3rd floor
Interlibrary loan requests take 3-5 business days

name: Financial Aid Office
description: Handles student loans, grants, scholarships, and work-study applications.

name: Computer Science Lab
description: Computer lab with workstations for CS coursework, available to declared CS majors.
additional_info: Printing is free for the first 50 pages per semester

name: Registrar's Office
description: Manages course registration, transcripts, and enrollment verification.
additional_info: Transcript requests can be made online

name: Cedar Hall Dining Commons
description: The main dining hall, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with vegetarian and vegan options.
additional_info: Meal swipes reset daily at midnight
